guardrails.title: No Synchronous I/O in Hot Paths
guardrails.body: Synchronous I/O (e.g. `readFileSync`) shall not be used inside loops or bulk-processing paths. Use streams or async APIs instead. acknowledged-exception handling: when a `## Matched Spec Acknowledgment Rationale` section is present for this guardrail, an intentional exception MAY pass only if the matched rationale comes from spec.json constraints, clarifications, or alternatives_considered, includes this guardrail_id at least once, and contains at least 20 non-whitespace characters after removing the guardrail_id. Example: `no-synchronous-io-in-hot-paths` is acknowledged because the synchronous read is limited to startup configuration before any loop or bulk-processing path runs.

guardrails.title: Validate User Input at Entry Point
guardrails.body: When adding or modifying CLI commands, the spec shall list each user-facing argument and its validation requirements (type, format, range). Arguments used only by internal automation shall be marked as internal. The implementation shall validate user-facing arguments at the entry point before passing them to internal functions.
